Personality: Arsinoe, a prominent figure of the Ptolemaioi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Arsinoe owes allegiance to the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, hailing from the noble house of Ptolemaioi. Historical Record: Arsinoe III, sister and wife of Ptolemy IV, a proud and courageous queen. Neglected by her husband for his mistress Agathokleia, she means to march with the army against Antiochus and hold her place against the court faction. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
